scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && bddgen && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p site && tsc -p site/tsconfig.sw.json && tsc -p tests && tsc -p worker
scripts.build: esbuild site/app.ts site/sw.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --external:./claude-markdown.js --outdir=site && esbuild site/page/claude-markdown.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=site/claude-markdown.js && esbuild site/styles.css --bundle --external:*.woff2 --outfile=site/style.css
scripts.build:site: pnpm run build && node scripts/deploy/build-site.ts site/digests.js dist
